title: 1 Peter 1:18-19 — the precious blood of Christ, a lamb unblemished and spotless
summary: 1 Peter 1:18-19 in English with key words coloured: silver, gold, blood, lamb, unblemished, spotless, Christ. The text says believers were redeemed not with silver or gold but with the precious blood of Christ, a lamb unblemished and spotless. The slide adds that the Messiah was a Lamb without blemish and without spot (ἀμώμου, amomos).

text.text: 18 knowing that you were not redeemed with perishable things like silver or gold from your futile way of life inherited from your forefathers,
19 but with precious blood, as of a lamb unblemished and spotless, the blood of Christ.
The Messiah was a Lamb without blemish and without spot (ἀμώμου, amomos.)

keywords: redeemed not with silver or gold
